args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money's docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per
FIN-212) but it actually quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent
(e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66), matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` was caused by a mismatch between `round_money`'s documented behavior and its implementation in `src/money.py`:

- **Docstring** already correctly described intent: "Round to cents using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), per FIN-212."
- **Implementation** incorrectly used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and use it in the `quantize` call.

## Effect

Half-cent values now round to the nearest even cent, matching FIN-212 and the existing test expectations:

| Amount | Before (`ROUND_HALF_UP`) | After (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) |
|---|---|---|
| 2.675 | 2.68 | 2.68 |
| 2.665 | **2.67** (test failure) | **2.66** ✅ |

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` (branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Review requested from @alex per team process.

Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite a docstring stating it should use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. So `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`, failing `tests/test_money.py`.
2. **Created branch** `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` off main and committed a one-line fix importing/using `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` with an explanatory commit message.
3. **Ran CI** (run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`) — it **passed**.
4. **Opened pull request** [payments-service#101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` with alex requested as reviewer. Merging to main will proceed once approved by a code owner.
